name: newsence
description: Save the articles, papers, posts and videos the assistant recommends to your Newsence library with one tap, and ask about what you saved, your notebooks and your documents.

interface.longDescription: Newsence shows the articles, papers, posts and videos the assistant recommends as cards. Press Save on a card to keep it in your Newsence library and public profile; nothing is saved without your press. Ask what you saved this week, or about a saved item, a notebook or a document you wrote, and the assistant reads it from your Newsence.
defaultPrompt: What did I save to Newsence this week?
Recommend five papers on agent evaluation to read
Summarize the latest thing I saved
